comparison.objective: Pour water onto soil while keeping foliage dry and restore the jug and leaf; candidate separates solid media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand deflects a springy leaf while the other controls liquid pouring, followed by restoration versus bimanual manipulation of a loaded rigid screen and selective particle passage.
comparison.success_condition: ≥90 ml delivered, ≤10 ml on leaves, jug and leaf restored, hands clear and 1-second hold versus ≥98% recovered media, no washer loss/spill, supported screen and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Both require selective routing while avoiding loss, but liquid pouring around an occluding compliant leaf is a different physical ability from aperture-based dry-media separation.
